goal: Based on Beyoncé in REFERENCE_0, retain recognizable facial features and elegant temperament, transforming the overall look to a high-quality hand-drawn style common in 2D animated films, single frame, non-3D.

reference_0.assumed_input: Assumed reference image: Half-length photo on the red carpet or indoor gala, with long wavy hair, exquisite eye makeup and contouring, main light coming from a studio or flash, background blurred

target_style: Japanese animated feature film (Ghibli style) hand-drawn feel: soft line art, large color blocks, layers of sky and grass green
hair: Deep brown large waves with edges showing slight hand-drawn line thickness variation, highlights in blocks rather than photographic speckles
makeup: Transformed into animated cel shading, eyelashes clear but not photo-realistic, lips in matte rose color.
outfit: Off-white and olive green striped button-up short jacket dress (without real brand logo), simple round earrings with metallic color to reduce reflective details
accessories: No sunglasses, a corner of the thin chiffon shawl slightly flutters in the wind.
scene: New scene: An afternoon hilly grass path, with a whimsical windmill and cumulus clouds in the distance, with a small amount of dandelion seeds drifting past the non-obscured face.
lighting: Soft scattered light at the zenith, warm earth yellow fill light on the cheek side, overall transparent without overexposure, and soft shadows.
rendering: 2D cel-shading + light watercolor grain background, non-Pixar 3D rendering

constraints.must_keep: Beyoncé's features are recognizable, with gender and ethnicity expressed respectfully and consistently.
constraints.forbid: Overly simplified cel animation leads to low-cost Flash-like images, background copy-paste grass textures, real trademarks or lyric watermarks
